blocks.text: The toolkit register adds the source, frequency, owner and target to each Tier 2 indicator in section 5.2.

Targets come from the growth model where it prints them and from the Inclusion Plan where it sets a pilot count. Elsewhere the target is a direction or a milestone, marked proposed where it is this report's choice; Steerco fixes the levels at Gate 1 once the 2027 baselines exist. Tier 1 targets are in section 5.3 and Tier 3 outputs in the charters.

blocks.text: The quarterly scorecard carries one row per indicator: code, name, baseline and year, latest value and date, direction against the path, target, source and owner. The annual Board outlook adds the Tier 1 chart against both paths and the gate status. The dashboard data model lists each feed, its refresh frequency and the manual-entry form for indicators without a feed. The templates themselves are delivered with the Excel toolkit [M&E toolkit workbook: Letsema to deliver with the final report].
